flags.observation: Expert dog whistles thin: only "constellation work" counts as insider reference; no precise name, date or quote in the intro.
Outro punch lands on money, but carries no expert dog whistle; "two grand a weekend" stays generic workshop satire.
"guru" appears three times in non-card frame text (beats 3, 52, 53), above the twice limit.
"Down in the sawdust:" only sets a place; no therefore/but link from Clown Shoe Shuffle, reads as and-then.
"Collapsed? Sell it:" bridge is cryptic; the logic leading into Spiritual Ego Check is not audible on first hearing.
"No way out?" sits two lines after "No apology, so:"; same No-opener family inside the ten-line distance.
Question-plus-one-word-colon cadence ("No words? Excuses:", "Collapsed? Sell it:", "Not family? Work:") recurs about six times; mechanical tic.
"a machine measuring imagined past decisions" carries the power wording where the art image sits; reads as rule paraphrase.
Trailing lone noun in "an armored guard, paranoia" makes a list fragment; same stacking pattern hampers one-breath phrasing elsewhere.
Style A specifies a female lead while the narrator says "I'm FrizzleBob, your carny rabbit"; voice persona mismatch.
